explanation: Bondy's conjecture (Conjecture 1 in Ma–Ning–Zhao): a k-connected graph with δ ≥ (n + k(k−1))/(k+1) has, for every longest cycle C, every path in G − V(C) with at most k − 1 vertices. Encoding "at most k − 1 vertices" as support length + 1 ≤ k is correct for k ≥ 1. Longest cycles are cycles whose length is the circumference, and paths are taken in the induced subgraph on the vertices off C. The paper says the conjecture is open for k ≥ 4. The statement is faithful and open.
